hero.badge: Higher Technician in Web Application Development
hero.description: Full Stack Developer trained in designing and building modern web applications. Skilled at integrating <bold>backend</bold> logic with dynamic <bold>frontend</bold> interfaces, with a strong ability to adapt to different environments, team methodologies, and new technologies.

lfk.role: Software Developer (FCT Internship) • Los Palacios y Villafranca (Seville), Spain
lfk.description: Full Stack development on a large-scale enterprise application. On the backend, <bold>creating new endpoints for REST APIs</bold> with <bold>Java (Spring Boot)</bold> and designing, creating, and modifying tables in a <bold>complex relational database</bold> using <bold>SQL</bold>. On the frontend, developing modular interfaces with <bold>Angular</bold>. Used <bold>Azure Storage</bold> for cloud file management and Git version control with <bold>Sourcetree</bold> during a 3-month internship (FCT).

dbc.role: IT Support Technician • Las Cabezas de San Juan (Seville), Spain
dbc.description: Comprehensive technical support and incident resolution across systems. Diagnosis and maintenance of <bold>hardware</bold>, networks, and peripherals, operating system optimization through installation and configuration from scratch, and advanced component-level repair of mobile devices.

statusTimer.title: StatusTimer
statusTimer.description: Real-time monitoring platform that centralizes server status, incidents, and multiplayer game launches, so users no longer need to check multiple sources. Full-Stack architecture with <bold>Next.js and TypeScript</bold> on the frontend, <bold>Java (Spring Boot)</bold> on the backend, and a <bold>Python</bold> data ingestion system that normalizes external data and exposes it through a custom <bold>REST API</bold>.
statusTimer.teamNote: <bold>First project deployed to production</bold>. Individual development: harvester design, API contracts, deployment on Vercel and Railway, and ongoing maintenance in a live environment.

readingVault.title: Reading Vault
readingVault.description: Full Stack digital platform for reading management. An end-to-end development built from scratch, <bold>co-designed in Figma</bold> and built on a modular architecture. Features a <bold>Java (Spring Boot) backend</bold> panel with a <bold>local REST API</bold> and its own <bold>MySQL</bold> database, combined with a dynamic <bold>React and TypeScript</bold> frontend that consumes external services.
readingVault.teamNote: <bold>Final team project for DAW</bold> in collaboration with: <link>Angeles de la Rosa</link>

proyectoCine.title: Proyecto Cine
proyectoCine.description: Interactive Full Stack web application developed for the DAW vocational program. Implements a real-time movie search and filtering system through <bold>external REST API consumption</bold> and a solid admin panel built with <bold>Laravel (PHP)</bold> and <bold>Angular</bold> on <bold>MySQL</bold> databases and <bold>Elasticsearch</bold> indexed storage.
proyectoCine.teamNote: <bold>Individual development</bold> for the DAW vocational program.
